title: The Cold Oven
scene: At 6:40 PM, the pizzeria oven was tampered with. The kitchen was closed for cleaning from 6:20 to 7:00.

suspects.name: Elsie Vale
suspects.testimony: I was at the counter at 6:40, taking orders.
suspects.alibiProof: The counter camera shows Elsie at 6:38.

suspects.name: Frank Pike
suspects.testimony: I was in the dining room at 6:40.
suspects.alibiProof: The dining camera shows Frank at 6:41.

suspects.name: Greta Reed
suspects.testimony: I was in the kitchen at 6:40, checking the ovens.
suspects.contradiction: The kitchen door was sealed for cleaning, and soot marked Greta's hands.

suspects.name: Hank Ash
suspects.testimony: I was loading the van at 6:40.
suspects.alibiProof: The van log shows Hank's scan at 6:39.
